scope: Uploaded frontend source only. Real Chromium source rendering with synthetic business responses and actual native print PDF. No production deployment or API writes.

test_method.browser: Chromium via Python Playwright; in-memory source rendering (set_content)
test_method.auth_responses: synthetic fixtures; actual transport/auth/math modules separately unit-tested
test_method.html2pdf_download_flow: mock renderer validates clone, controls, cancellation, timeout and save guard

not_verified: Real hosted page navigation and service-worker installation/update (localhost navigation blocked by environment)
Live Apps Script response schema, role enforcement, inventory and transactional concurrency
Real external html2pdf/html2canvas/jsPDF rasterization and CDN loading; original dependency retained
Actual iOS/Android devices and native app behavior
Live GitHub Actions execution and published Pages settings
Server invoice-register uniqueness/persistence, email delivery and payment collection
packaged_artifact_policy: Distributed ZIP is separately extracted and the source-verification and source-browser suites are rerun. External delivery receipt records the exact ZIP hash and those results; this internal report records the source-tree run.
